title: FastAPI Hello Route
description: Trace how a simple GET request reaches a FastAPI route and becomes a JSON response.
learning_objectives: Identify the client, route, and response parts of a backend request.
Explain how a GET request maps to a FastAPI route function.
Describe how a Python dictionary becomes a JSON response.

lifecycle_nodes.label: Client request
lifecycle_nodes.description: A browser or API client asks for GET /hello.

lifecycle_nodes.label: GET /hello route
lifecycle_nodes.description: FastAPI matches the path and method to the hello route function.

lifecycle_nodes.label: JSON response
lifecycle_nodes.description: The returned dictionary becomes a JSON response with status 200.

hints: Start by finding the decorator that names the HTTP method and path.
The route function body decides what data is returned.
In FastAPI, returning a dictionary usually becomes a JSON response.
